description: Runs Trustabl Probe on a directory of agent tool code (Python, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, Ruby, Shell). Static analysis always runs; with sandbox 'auto' (default) the tool is also run in an isolated, network-blocked sandbox when Docker or OpenShell is ready, which catches problems that only show up at runtime. Returns a readiness score, the draft network allow list (an OpenShell network policy), and findings worst-first, each with a fix hint for you to apply. Writes network_policies.draft.yaml, probe.findings.json, probe.profile.json and autofix-attestation.json into the scanned directory.

allow_write_tools.description: Run tools that look destructive (network writes, deletes, payments) in the sandbox too. Default false: they are skipped and only analyzed statically. Only set true when the user asks.

entrypoints.description: Entry point files inside the directory, e.g. ['tool.py']. Default: Probe discovers them.

path.description: Directory with the tool code. Defaults to the current directory.

sandbox.description: 'auto' (default) uses the sandbox when a runner is ready; 'on' fails without one; 'off' is static only.

name: probe_scan
title: Scan an agent tool with Probe
